baseline: Working source after road height subdivision and exact rendered-surface car pose fix

methodology.oracle: Independent XZ barycentric interpolation from actual createRoadNetwork Float32 surface position/index buffers, never new roadSurface.sample output.
methodology.road_ownership: Each vehicle is compared with its own source road. Separate global same-grade surface:0 checks exclude bridge:2 overhead ribbons.
methodology.terrain: Recreated the scene PlaneGeometry(meta.width, meta.depth, 120, 120), rotateX(-PI/2), and exact illustrative-hills surfaceHeight at its vertices; triangle interpolation used for occlusion checks.
methodology.xz_samples: At most one source metre between route samples. Both directions where legal. Complete footprint extends to lamp extremity +/-0.5245 car length and +/-0.5 car width.
methodology.physical_units: Distances converted using city meta.unitsPerMeter=0.02. These are internal model-equivalent metres, not surveyed road elevations.
methodology.limitations: CPU geometry audit; no WebGL rasterization, shadows or visual browser assessment. Authored model exclusion uses complete registered XZ bounding footprints, not every GLB triangle.

roadGeometrySummary.legacyPivotGapMeaning: minPivotGapM/maxPivotGapM here quantify legacy terrain-following pivot against repaired roads; actual new car pose is audited below.

actualVehicleMatrices.mode: actual InstancedMesh matrix transformed body bottom and complete lamp envelope; own source road triangle barycentric interpolation
